mia: Quick sync — PRD acceptance criteria for the 'Latency guardrails' initiative. Draft below, want alignment on SLIs/SLOs/graceful-degrade behavior. @arjun @lina please weigh in :thinking:

arjun: Do we split SLIs by completion length and streaming vs non-streaming?

mia: yes — short/medium/long buckets and streaming measured by TTFB + per-token tail; non-streaming by end-to-end latency.

lina: propose buckets: short <128, medium 128-1024, long >1024. Use 5m and 24h rolling windows for alerts.

sam: UX fallback copy needed — what customers see when we degrade.

arjun: tentative SLOs: short p95<=350ms p99<=800ms; medium p95<=700ms p99<=1500ms; long p95<=1500ms p99<=3000ms. Dedicated tighten p95 by ~20%.

lina: error budget: 0.2% monthly for hosted API. Define error = HTTP 5xx OR generation failures OR latency breaches >p99.

mia: acceptance criteria (draft):
- SLI instrumentation for all buckets and streaming TTFB
- Dashboards per-model+per-region SLO view and error-budget burn-down
- Canary: 1% traffic with synthetic traffic + 3d shadow
- Rollback policy: auto-fallback to smaller quantized variant on p99 breach >5m
- Customer behavior: return cached/shorter reply or 503 with Retry-After when degrade triggers

arjun: fallback chain preference: model variants -> degraded features -> fail fast. Example config block provided.

lina: edge cases: cold-start spikes ignore first 60s per node; long-running streaming cap tokens and send termination; regional failover routing.

sam: UX copy drafts: Minor degrade 'Response shortened to preserve performance. Full result available if you retry.' Full degrade 'Service temporarily degraded. Please retry in a few seconds.' :hourglass_flowing_sand:

mia: add acceptance test suite run with each release: synthetic steady-state + burst tests as gates.

arjun: will add SLI instrumentation + fallback config (owner) due EOD Thu; opening RFC PR.

lina: will add dashboards+alerts+canary automation due EOD Fri; will add golden prompts list to RFC checklist.

sam: will add copy and modal example to RFC.

ops-bot: Canary deploy started for latency-guardrails v1 on us-west-2 (1% traffic). Logs -> https://deploys.internal/latency-guardrails/1773007890

deploy-bot: Canary deployment health: OK, 1% traffic, 0.05% error rate, p95(short)=320ms, p99(short)=770ms

mia: locking acceptance criteria by EOD unless objections. I'll paste final wording into PRD after owners confirm PRs.

arjun: no objections from eng.

lina: no objections from SRE.

sam: :+1:
